Use case: stylized-concept. Create a polished landscape 16:9 original 2D side-scrolling action-adventure concept art board for Whale Fall: Echoes of the Tide, V4.2. Image 1 is ONLY the owned protagonist identity reference. Image 2 is ONLY the owned clean hand-drawn rendering reference, not a layout to repeat. Visual language: confident dark ink outlines, broad 2-3 tone cel masses, sparse dry-brush texture, moody poetic underwater ruin atmosphere, very dark foreground silhouettes, crisply readable playable midground, faded low-contrast background, readable enemies and landing surfaces. Entire world is within one dead whale; shell settlements and red repair knots signify an extinct miniature culture. Hero is 30cm and three heads tall, with a single circular dark diving lens in round ivory helmet, short petrol-teal cape, charcoal webbed feet, sealed amber hip lamp, U-shaped two-prong bone resonator tethered by coral-red rope. This is original IP; interpret hand-drawn atmospheric action principles, never copy specific game assets. 
Scene-specific brief: A wide single continuous playable side-view scene inside the mouth of a dead baleen whale. Baleen hangs ONLY from the upper jaw. Broad tongue terraces, old empty shell shelters with red repair knots, deep navy and desaturated amber. Tiny Tidekeeper at lower center strikes an exposed crab flank with the U-shaped resonator, compact cyan impact arc. A second crab telegraphs a raised claw from farther right, NOT overlapping attacks. Visible upper optional ledge with shrimp current, lower recovery ramp, right exit latch, upper sealed amber specimen capsule. Three clear route choices, convincing foreground/midground/background. No arrows or labels; do not turn into a poster.
